message.content:
This editorial illustration is the cover of a magazine titled "TEMPO". The word "TEMPO" is written in large red block letters across the top. Above it, text reads "Wadas Ditindas, Wadas Melawan H.86" and "Penjarah Tanah Pertamina H.68". Below the title, the phrase "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" appears. To the right, a barcode, a QR code, the date "14-20 FEBRUARI 2022", and other pricing information are visible.

The center features three men. The leftmost man wears a white collared shirt and points toward a rolled white paper held by the man in the center. The center man wears a light blue shirt, a dark blue vest, a black tie, and glasses. He holds a large, rolled paper with both hands. To the right, a third man in a red shirt with a logo holds a yellow and black surveying tripod. All three men look downward.

The bottom portion shows a large, modern building with a vertical, ribbed facade resembling wings. In front of it is a green courtyard with a fountain, palm trees, and an Indonesian flag on a tall pole. The background consists of a blue sky with horizontal white streaks and a dense green forest surrounding the building. The headline "Lagak Kompak Ibu Kota" is positioned to the left of the men, with additional descriptive text below it.
